title: AutoFlame TNT&FB
description: It's a crazy awesome TNT and FB plugin!
body:
TNT&FB Plugin
TNT&FB is a simple yet powerful Minecraft plugin that adds two useful features to your server:

🔥 Auto-Igniting TNT
When a player places a TNT block, it will automatically ignite and become a primed TNT entity.

Explodes just like normal TNT, but without the need to manually ignite it.

This feature is controlled globally and can be toggled by server administrators via commands.

💥 Enhanced Fireball Launcher
Right-click with a Fire Charge to launch a powerful fireball in the direction you're looking.

The fireball has double the explosive power of a normal one (Power: 5.0).

This feature can be toggled individually for each player.

🔧 Commands
Command	Description
/TNT	Toggle auto-igniting TNT globally
/TNT true	Enable auto-igniting TNT
/TNT false	Disable auto-igniting TNT
/FB	Toggle enhanced fireball per player
/FB true	Enable enhanced fireball launching
/FB false	Disable enhanced fireball launching

🛡️ Permissions
tntfb.infinite — Players with this permission won’t consume a fire charge when launching fireballs.

🧱 Compatibility
Works on Spigot, Bukkit, and Paper servers running Minecraft 1.16.5 and above

Tested on 1.20.1

May work on other versions, but not officially supported

📥 Installation
Download the plugin .jar file

Place it in your server’s /plugins folder

Restart or reload your server

📌 Planned Features
Config file support (e.g., TNT fuse time, fireball power)

Multi-language support

If you'd like, I can also format it for Markdown or help you write a more promotional version for Modrinth or SpigotMC.
